statuses.supported: Proven end to end by executable evidence.
statuses.partial: Only part of the journey is currently proven.
statuses.recognition_only: Related evidence is recognizable; the full journey is not proven.
statuses.missing: The current model or services do not support the complete journey.
statuses.out_of_scope: Deliberately outside the current product scope.

entries.title: Standard order: one customer, one line, in stock
entries.question: Is it committed, reserved, shipped, invoiced, paid?
entries.summary: Reality derives the customer invoice's open amount from its posted receivable and the payments or credits allocated to it. The invoice is fully settled when the derived open amount reaches zero; an allocation that covers only part leaves the remainder open.

localized_summaries.de: Reality leitet den offenen Betrag einer Kundenrechnung aus der gebuchten Forderung und den zugeordneten Zahlungen oder Gutschriften ab. Die Rechnung ist vollständig ausgeglichen, sobald der offene Betrag null erreicht; eine Teilzahlung lässt den Rest offen.

question_examples: Standard order: one customer, one line, in stock
Is it committed, reserved, shipped, invoiced, paid?
How does Reality know whether a customer invoice is fully paid?
Wie erkenne ich, dass eine Kundenrechnung vollständig bezahlt ist?

entries.title: Order with 30 lines from several warehouses
entries.question: What is open per line and per location?
entries.summary: Reality evaluates: What is open per line and per location?

entries.title: Customer raises the quantity after a partial delivery

The excess delivery is not reported.

entries.summary: Reality evaluates: Is only that commitment closed and its reservation released?

entries.title: Whole order cancelled after reservation
entries.question: Are all reservations released?
entries.summary: Reality evaluates: Are all reservations released?

entries.title: Cancelled after picking, before shipment
entries.question: Does the stock go back, and is that visible?
entries.summary: Reality evaluates: Does the stock go back, and is that visible?

entries.title: "Cancelled" after shipment
entries.question: Is it treated as a return or refusal, not a cancellation?
entries.summary: Reality evaluates: Is it treated as a return or refusal, not a cancellation?
limitations: A cancellation that arrives after full shipment is held for review without effect, and a delivered line cannot be cancelled.
It is not yet classified as a return or a refusal.
question_examples: Is it treated as a return or refusal, not a cancellation?

entries.title: Customer swaps a variant/size in an open order
entries.question: Old commitment closed, new one opened, history kept?
entries.summary: Reality evaluates: Old commitment closed, new one opened, history kept?
limitations: Lines cannot be added to an order once it is in operation, and changed shop orders are held for review.
Swapping a variant on the same order while keeping its history is therefore not possible.

entries.title: Delivery address changes after release, before shipment

limitations: The delivery address is kept on the order only; a shipment does not record the address it used.
Which address a shipment went to, and when it changed, cannot be answered.

entries.title: Partial delivery: 3 of 5 shipped
entries.question: Open 2, shipped 3?
entries.summary: Reality records the shipped quantity and derives the open remainder from the order commitment. If 3 of 5 units are shipped, 3 remain fulfilled and 2 remain open for a later shipment.

localized_summaries.de: Reality erfasst die versendete Menge und leitet die offene Restmenge aus der Auftragszusage ab. Werden 3 von 5 Einheiten geliefert, bleiben 3 erfüllt und 2 für eine spätere Lieferung offen.

entries.question: Movements per location, one commitment?

entries.title: Customer pickup
entries.question: Fulfilled without a carrier?
entries.summary: Reality evaluates: Fulfilled without a carrier?

Pickup is not recorded as a delivery mode of its own.

entries.title: Free replacement shipment without a new order

limitations: A free replacement is recorded as an exchange against a return or an announcement; a replacement without either, such as for a lost parcel, has no reviewed path yet.

entries.title: Shipment reported twice

limitations: Returnable packaging and the deposit owed for it are not tracked.

entries.question: Shipped but not invoiced = 0?
entries.summary: Reality derives the shipped-but-not-invoiced quantity per order line across customer invoices. Each partial shipment can be invoiced separately; once invoiced quantities cover the shipped quantities, the unbilled quantity reaches zero.

entries.title: Monthly collective invoice over several shipments

entries.summary: Reality can collect billable positions from several shipments and record them on one customer invoice. Once those positions are invoiced, their shipped-but-not-invoiced quantities clear.

localized_summaries.de: Reality kann abrechenbare Positionen aus mehreren Lieferungen in einer Kundenrechnung zusammenfassen. Nach der Fakturierung sind diese gelieferten Mengen nicht mehr als noch nicht berechnet offen.

entries.title: Invoice corrected: reversal plus new invoice

entries.title: Credit note with returned goods

localized_summaries.de: Reality verbindet die Warenrückgabe und die rechnungsbezogene Gutschrift über dieselbe Auftragszeile. Eine zusätzliche direkte Verknüpfung zwischen Retourenbewegung und Gutschrift ist nicht erforderlich. Sobald die verknüpfte Gutschrift vorhanden ist, verschwindet die Ausnahme „retourniert, aber noch nicht gutgeschrieben“.

entries.title: Dunning in three levels, then collection
entries.question: Dunning notices from open items?
entries.summary: Reality evaluates: Dunning notices from open items? A person starts a dunning run over all or selected customers; each overdue item is proposed at its next level with the fee the schedule states, and after level 3 it is handed to collection with a delivery hold. An agent can prepare the run; a person confirms it.
limitations: Letters and emails are not sent; the notice is recorded evidence.
The schedule is one per company with a fixed fee per level, charged in each notice's currency; interest is not calculated.
Disputed items are not known to Reality; the person deselects them in the review.
question_examples: Dunning in three levels, then collection
Run the reminders for all overdue invoices and escalate to the next level
Mahnlauf über alle überfälligen Rechnungen und danach ans Inkasso
